mapper.select: SELECT PROD_ID as prodId, STR_TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') as holdDate, MDATE as busiMDate, IFNULL(BALANCE_AMT,0) as prdBalanceAmt, IFNULL(PRD_QTY,0) as prdTotalQty, IFNULL(TOTAL_AMT,0) as prdRaiseTotalAmt, IFNULL(RAISE_QTY,0) as prdRaiseTotalQty, IFNULL(SUM(CNY_AMT),0) as investBalanceAmt, IFNULL(SUM(QTY),0) as investTotalQty, REG_CODE as prdRegistCode FROM ( SELECT @rownum :=@rownum +1 rownum, tmp1.PROD_ID, tmp1.MDATE, tmp1.BALANCE_AMT, tmp1.PRD_QTY, tmp1.TOTAL_AMT, tmp1.RAISE_QTY, CASE WHEN C.STATUS = '03' THEN 0 ELSE C.CNY_AMT END CNY_AMT, CASE WHEN C.STATUS = '03' THEN 0 ELSE C.QTY END QTY, D.REG_CODE, IF ((@PROD_ID = tmp1.PROD_ID AND @MDATE = tmp1.MDATE), @rank :=@rank + 1, @rank :=1 ) AS hodeStsNo, @PROD_ID := tmp1.PROD_ID, @MDATE := tmp1.MDATE FROM (SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PROD_ID, MDATE, BALANCE_AMT, PRD_QTY, TOTAL_AMT, RAISE_QTY FROM( SELECT @rownum :=@rownum +1 rownum, A.PROD_ID, A.MDATE, A.BALANCE_AMT, A.PRD_QTY, B.TOTAL_AMT, B.RAISE_QTY, IF ((@PROD_ID = A.PROD_ID AND @MDATE = A.MDATE), @rank :=@rank + 1, @rank :=1 ) AS raiseStatusNo, @PROD_ID := A.PROD_ID, @MDATE := A.MDATE FROM (SELECT * FROM () FF ORDER BY PROD_ID,MDATE, UPDATE_TIME ) A, (SELECT @rownum :=0, @PROD_ID := NULL,@MDATE := NULL, @rank := 0) tmp INNER JOIN CHB_PRD_RAISETOT_SUB B ON A.PROD_ID = B.PROD_ID ) WHERE raiseStatusNo = 1 ) ff ORDER BY MDATE,INDENTIFY_MARK, UPDATE_TIME ) tmp1, (SELECT @rownum :=0, @PROD_ID := NULL, @MDATE := NULL,@rank := 0) tmp LEFT JOIN CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE D ON tmp1.PROD_ID = D.PRODID LEFT JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB C ON tmp1.PROD_ID = C.PRODID WHERE STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(C.HOLD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y-%m-%d') = STR_TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') ) gg WHERE hodeStsNo = 1 GROUP BY PROD_ID, REG_CODE, MDATE, BALANCE_AMT, PRD_QTY, TOTAL_AMT, RAISE_QTY
